newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Hungarian President Arpad Goncz will start a three-day visit to Romania on May 25 for talks with President Emil Constantinescu, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and parliament chairmen, foreign ministry spokeswoman Gilda Lazar said.
She said Goncz will visit the Transylvanian cities of Cluj and Tirgu Mures.
Goncz is also expected to address a joint session of parliament, Lazar said. Romania and Hungary will sign accords on tourism and environmental protection during Goncz's visit.
* A Romanian delegation will attend the conference of energy ministers of EU members and associate countries.
* The State Ownership Fund (FPS) will open a business centre at Bucharest's World Trade Centre on Wednesday.
The FPS is also expected to sign a contract to sell 51 percent of plane maker IAR Brasov to U.S. helicopter maker Bell Helicopter Textron .
* Parliament's foreign policy commissions have started to hear candidates for ambassadors to several European capitals.
* Romania will become increasingly active on international capital markets, Ciorbea said at the opening of a central bank seminar on the development of capital markets.
